# EvalOps API Documentation for LLMs

This file provides machine-readable information about the EvalOps API for AI agents.

## API Overview

EvalOps is a microservices platform built as an Nx monorepo with seven NestJS microservices plus a React frontend.

## API Gateway

**Base URL**: `http://localhost:3000/api` (development)  
**Swagger Docs**: `http://localhost:3000/api/docs`

All requests go through the API Gateway, which routes by path prefix:

- `/api/auth/*` → auth-service (port 3001)
- `/api/core/*` → core-service (port 3002)
- `/api/evaluation/*` → evaluation-service (port 3003)
- `/api/integration/*` → integration-service (port 3004)
- `/api/analytics/*` → analytics-service (port 3005)

## Authentication

All endpoints (except `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/register`, `/api/auth/logout`, and health checks) require a JWT Bearer token.

**Get token:**
```bash
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "password"
}
```

**Use token:**
```bash
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## Service Endpoints

### Auth Service (port 3001)
- `POST /api/auth/register` - Register new user
- `POST /api/auth/login` - Login and get JWT token
- `GET /api/auth/user` - Get current user
- `GET|POST /api/auth/users` - User management (admin only)
- `GET|POST /api/auth/organizations` - Organization management

**Swagger**: `http://localhost:3001/api/docs`

### Core Service (port 3002)
- `GET /api/core/prompts` - List prompts
- `POST /api/core/prompts` - Create prompt
- `GET /api/core/datasets` - List datasets
- `POST /api/core/datasets` - Create dataset
- `GET /api/core/agents` - List agents (AgentMD format)
- `POST /api/core/agents` - Create agent
- `GET /api/core/eval-specs` - List evaluation specs
- `POST /api/core/eval-specs` - Create evaluation spec

**Swagger**: `http://localhost:3002/api/docs`

### Evaluation Service (port 3003)
- `POST /api/evaluation/runs` - Create evaluation run
- `GET /api/evaluation/runs/:id` - Get run details
- `POST /api/evaluation/ingestion/events` - Ingest trace events (rate-limited: 100/min)
- `GET /api/evaluation/policies` - List policies
- `POST /api/evaluation/policies` - Create policy

**Swagger**: `http://localhost:3003/api/docs`

### Integration Service (port 3004)
- `GET /api/integration/artifacts/:runId/:file` - Get artifact download URL
- `POST /api/integration/webhooks` - Create webhook
- `GET /api/integration/webhooks` - List webhooks

**Swagger**: `http://localhost:3004/api/docs`

### Analytics Service (port 3005)
- `GET /api/analytics/dashboard` - Dashboard metrics
- `GET /api/analytics/audit-trail` - Audit trail
- `GET /api/analytics/cost-analytics` - Cost breakdown

**Swagger**: `http://localhost:3005/api/docs`

## OpenAPI Specifications

Each service exposes OpenAPI/Swagger documentation at `/api/docs`:

- API Gateway: http://localhost:3000/api/docs
- Auth Service: http://localhost:3001/api/docs
- Core Service: http://localhost:3002/api/docs
- Evaluation Service: http://localhost:3003/api/docs
- Integration Service: http://localhost:3004/api/docs
- Analytics Service: http://localhost:3005/api/docs

To get OpenAPI JSON spec:
- Add `/api/docs-json` to any service URL (e.g., `http://localhost:3000/api/docs-json`)

## Data Models

### Evaluation Run
```typescript
{
  id: string;
  evalSpecId: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed';
  results: {
    passRate: number;
    scores: Record<string, number>;
  };
  costUsd: number;
  traceEvents?: any[]; // JSONB, max 10MB
}
```

### Agent (AgentMD format)
```yaml
---
name: my-agent
version: "1.0.0"
description: Agent description
model:
  provider: openai
  name: gpt-4o
  temperature: 0.1
tools:
  - tool1
  - tool2
---
System prompt here...
```

### Evaluation Spec
```typescript
{
  id: string;
  name: string;
  datasetId: string;
  promptId?: string;
  agentId?: string;
  evaluators: Array<{
    type: 'exact' | 'llm_judge' | 'rule';
    config: any;
  }>;
}
```

## Rate Limiting

- Trace ingestion endpoint: 100 requests per user per minute
- Other endpoints: No rate limiting (handled by gateway)

## Multi-Tenant Isolation

All data is isolated by organization via Row Level Security (RLS). The `TenantInterceptor` automatically sets `app.org_id` from the JWT payload.
